title: Disabled SMBs on G7 with xDrip as a collector
body:
I am using a G7 with xDrip+ (latest nightly) as collector. On the latest dev version (merged with my code today), I found that AAPS disables SMBs despite them being switched on in the preferences.

The constraints section states:
"Safety: SMB always and after carbs disabled because active BG source doesn't support advanced filtering."

I have found this was already discussed and fixed in August for when xDrip is fed by the Dexcom app:

https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/pull/3411

However, in my case, xDrip is the collector so these cases are similar but not identical. I am currently brute-forcing SMBs by setting advancedFiltering = true.

Disclaimer: I am running the Tsunami version of AAPS, but this issue does not seem to be related to any of my mods and also occurs with oref1.
